title: DeepSeek-V4: Sparse Attention, Million-Token Default
hook: DeepSeek-V4 makes a 1M-token context window the default and pairs token-wise compression with sparse attention, so long-context inference no longer pays the usual compute and memory tax.
key_points: Two MoE variants: DeepSeek-V4-Pro (1.6T total / 49B active) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash (284B total / 13B active).
A 1M-token context window is now the default across DeepSeek's services.
Introduces token-wise compression plus DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) for long-context efficiency.
Claims drastically reduced compute and memory costs at long context.
API available day-one in OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible formats; weights on Hugging Face. Labeled a preview release.
content_html: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4 as a preview in April 2026, a pair of mixture-of-experts models built around long-context efficiency. The headline change: a 1M-token context window is now the default across DeepSeek's services, made affordable by new compression and sparse-attention techniques.
extra_html:
What's new

V4 ships in two MoE variants - DeepSeek-V4-Pro at 1.6T total parameters with 49B active, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash at 284B total with 13B active. To make million-token context the default rather than a premium option, V4 introduces token-wise compression alongside DSA, DeepSeek Sparse Attention, with claims of drastically reduced compute and memory costs at long context.

Why it matters

Attention cost normally grows sharply with context length, which is why huge windows tend to be slow and expensive; compressing tokens and attending sparsely is how DeepSeek argues it can offer a 1M-token default. The API is available day-one in OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible formats and the weights are on Hugging Face, though this is labeled a preview. See DeepSeek's release notes for details.

related.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
related.hook: DeepSeek-V3 trained a frontier-class MoE model for a fraction of the cost of comparable closed models, using FP8 training and a novel load-balancing scheme to make efficiency the headline result.

related.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
related.hook: DeepSeek shows strong reasoning can emerge from RL on verifiable rewards with minimal supervised data - and those reasoning traces can be distilled into smaller models.

related.title: What Is a Mixture of Experts?
related.hook: Instead of running every input through one big network, route each token to a few specialist sub-networks - total capacity grows without proportional compute.

related.title: SLAI T-Rex: Post-training a Trillion-Param MoE on Ascend Chips
related.hook: Full-parameter post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 family on Huawei's Ascend NPUs — not NVIDIA GPUs — hitting a 2.93x efficiency jump over the open-source baseline.
